jobs.name: Weekly ensemble retrain
jobs.description: Joint-model retrain to keep ensemble below the 7-day CRITICAL staleness threshold. Disabled by default — enable AFTER you have verified the retrain pipeline runs cleanly in your environment (it overwrites .pkl files under trained_data/models/*). The default cadence matches the script's docstring (Mon 10:00 UTC, London session). Add more entries — e.g. weekly_WED_10:00, weekly_FRI_10:00 — to approximate the original MWF launchd schedule.
